info.title: Admin API
info.description: The Lunar admin API. Generated from the resource registry; add-on fields and endpoints appear automatically.

tags.name: products
tags.description: Every product in the catalogue, whatever its state, with raw attribute data and locale maps.

tags.name: variants
tags.description: A variant of a product with its stock levels and prices.

tags.name: prices
tags.description: A price of a variant for one currency, quantity break and customer group.

tags.name: brands
tags.description: Every brand in the catalogue, whatever its state.

tags.name: api-keys
tags.description: Credentials for the admin API. The token is returned once, when the key is issued; revoked keys stay listed for the audit trail.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
Comma-separated related resources to embed, nested with dots up to 3 levels.

- `brand`: The brand, null when the product has none.
- `variants`: Every variant of the product.
- `variants.product`: The parent product.
- `variants.product.brand`: The brand, null when the product has none.
- `variants.product.variants`: Every variant of the product.
- `variants.prices`: Every price of the variant.

parameters.name: fields

products.description: Comma-separated fields of products to return: name, description, short_description, status, brand_id, product_type_id, attribute_data, created_at, updated_at, brand, variants.

brands.description: Comma-separated fields of brands to return: name, handle, status, description, short_description, created_at, updated_at.

variants.description: Comma-separated fields of variants to return: sku, gtin, mpn, ean, enabled, unit_quantity, min_quantity, quantity_increment, shippable, selling_policy, tax_ref, stock_on_hand, stock_available, created_at, updated_at, product, prices.

prices.description: Comma-separated fields of prices to return: price, list_price, currency, min_quantity, customer_group_id.

parameters.description: Sparse fieldsets per resource type, for example `fields[products]=name,slug`. `id` and `type` are always returned.

parameters.name: filter

id.description: Match by public id. Operators: eq, ne, in, not_in.

status.description: Match by lifecycle state. Operators: eq, ne, in, not_in.

brand.description: Products of the brand with this public id. Operators: eq, in.

sku.description: Products with a variant matching this SKU. Operators: eq, in, like.

updated_at.description: Products changed before or after an instant, for incremental sync. Operators: gt, gte, lt, lte.

parameters.description: Filters, for example `filter[handle]=acme` or `filter[price][gte]=1000`. `filter[name]=value` is shorthand for the `eq` operator.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma-separated sort keys; prefix a key with `-` to sort descending.

- `created_at`: By creation time.
- `updated_at`: By last change.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The public id of the product.

parameters.name: fields

api-keys.description: Comma-separated fields of api-keys to return: name, token_prefix, abilities, staff_id, active, last_used_at, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at.

parameters.description: Sparse fieldsets per resource type, for example `fields[products]=name,slug`. `id` and `type` are always returned.

parameters.name: filter

id.description: Match by public id. Operators: eq, ne, in, not_in.

name.description: Match by name. Operators: eq, like.

active.description: Only keys that are neither revoked nor expired when true. Operators: eq.

parameters.description: Filters, for example `filter[handle]=acme` or `filter[price][gte]=1000`. `filter[name]=value` is shorthand for the `eq` operator.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma-separated sort keys; prefix a key with `-` to sort descending.

- `name`: Alphabetical by name.
- `created_at`: By issue time.
- `last_used_at`: By last use.

post.description: Creates a key with the given abilities. The plaintext token is returned in this response only; store it securely.

name.description: A label for the integration the key belongs to.

abilities.description: Permission handles to grant, from the staff permission manifest, or * for every permission. At least one.

staff_id.description: Public id of the staff member the key acts as. Omit for a service key.

expires_at.description: When the key stops authenticating. Must be in the future; omit for no expiry.

201.description: The issued key with its plaintext token.

token.description: The plaintext bearer token. Store it now; it is not retrievable later.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The public id of the API key.

parameters.name: fields

api-keys.description: Comma-separated fields of api-keys to return: name, token_prefix, abilities, staff_id, active, last_used_at, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at.

parameters.description: Sparse fieldsets per resource type, for example `fields[products]=name,slug`. `id` and `type` are always returned.

delete.description: Stops the key authenticating. Revoked keys stay listed so the audit trail keeps its actor.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The public id of the resource.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Every product in the catalogue, whatever its state, with raw attribute data and locale maps.

id.description: The public id of the product.

name.description: The product name, keyed by locale.

description.description: The long description, keyed by locale.

short_description.description: The short description, keyed by locale.

status.description: Lifecycle state: draft, published or archived.

brand_id.description: Public id of the brand, or null.

product_type_id.description: Public id of the product type.

attribute_data.description: Raw attribute values keyed by handle; translatable attributes are locale maps.

updated_at.description: When the product was last updated.

brand.description: The brand, null when the product has none. Present when included.

variants.description: Every variant of the product. Present when included.

Variant.title: Variant
Variant.description: A variant of a product with its stock levels and prices.

id.description: The public id of the variant.

enabled.description: Whether the variant is offered for sale.

min_quantity.description: Smallest quantity that can be added to a cart.

selling_policy.description: How the variant sells relative to its stock.

tax_ref.description: Reference the tax driver uses to classify the variant.

stock_available.description: Units available to sell after commitments and reservations.

updated_at.description: When the variant was last updated.

product.description: The parent product. Present when included.

prices.description: Every price of the variant. Present when included.

Price.title: Price
Price.description: A price of a variant for one currency, quantity break and customer group.

id.description: The public id of the price.

list_price.description: The recommended or was price, when one is set.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the price currency.

min_quantity.description: The quantity from which this price applies.

customer_group_id.description: Public id of the customer group the price is for, or null for every group.

Brand.title: Brand
Brand.description: Every brand in the catalogue, whatever its state.

id.description: The public id of the brand.

status.description: Lifecycle state, such as active or archived.

description.description: The long description, keyed by locale.

short_description.description: The short description, keyed by locale.

updated_at.description: When the brand was last updated.

ApiKey.title: API key
ApiKey.description: Credentials for the admin API. The token is returned once, when the key is issued; revoked keys stay listed for the audit trail.

id.description: The public id of the api key.

name.description: A label for the integration the key belongs to.

token_prefix.description: The first characters of the token, to identify a key without exposing it.

abilities.description: Permission handles the key was granted, or * for every permission.

staff_id.description: Public id of the staff member the key acts as, or null for a service key.

active.description: Whether the key is neither revoked nor expired.

last_used_at.description: When the key last authenticated a request.

expires_at.description: When the key stops authenticating, or null for no expiry.

revoked_at.description: When the key was revoked, or null while it is live.

updated_at.description: When the key was last changed.

Money.title: Money
Money.description: A monetary amount in minor units with its currency, so arithmetic never needs to know the decimal places.

amount.description: The amount in minor units (pence, cents).

decimal_places.description: Minor units per major unit, as a power of ten.

formatted.description: The amount formatted for the request locale.

TranslationMap.title: TranslationMap
TranslationMap.description: A translatable value: one entry per locale code.

status.description: The HTTP status, as a string.

code.description: A stable machine-readable code, such as unknown_filter or validation_failed.

detail.description: What went wrong for this occurrence.

source.description: Where the error originated: a query parameter, a JSON pointer into the body, or a header.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Every error response: one or more error objects.

PaginationMeta.title: PaginationMeta
PaginationMeta.description: Page-number pagination, or cursor pagination when the request used page[cursor].

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null on the last.

prev_cursor.description: Cursor for the previous page, or null on the first.

Links.title: Links
Links.description: Navigation links. Only self is present on item responses.

Unauthorized.description: The credential is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The credential lacks the ability this endpoint requires.

NotFound.description: No resource with that id is visible to the request.

UnprocessableEntity.description: A query parameter, header or body field is invalid. Each error names its source.

TooManyRequests.description: The rate limit was exceeded. Retry after the Retry-After header.

apiKey.description: An admin API key issued with `lunar:api:key create` or `POST /api-keys`, or a token of the guard named by `lunar.api.admin.guard`. Abilities gate endpoints and fields; see `x-lunar-requires`.
